description: Defines the One2OneBeanRelationship class for managing one-to-one relationships in SuiteCRM, extending the base relationship class, including methods for adding relationships, updating links, and generating SQL join statements.

classes.name: One2OneBeanRelationship
classes.description: A class representing a one-to-one bean relationship in SuiteCRM, with methods to add relationships, update links, and generate SQL join clauses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the relationship with a definition.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship between two beans, removing existing links first.

methods.name: updateLinks
methods.description: Updates the relationship links between the left and right beans.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL join statement for the relationship, with options for aliasing and filtering.
